_note: Real event pack for LA Hacks AI Hackathon (Oct 17-18 2026, UCLA). ORGANIZATIONS ONLY: no individual people. Add consenting demo people to the top-level people array and each org's people list. eventRole is generic ('sponsor') because per-sponsor prize tracks were not published on lahacks pages we could read (JS-rendered); fill in from the Devpost/Discord before the demo. Facts are public org info with source URLs, researched 2026-10-17.

organizations.name: LA Hacks
organizations.oneLiner: Student-run nonprofit hackathon at UCLA; the host of this event.

focusNow.text: LA Hacks is a free student hackathon run by a 501(c)(3) nonprofit and student volunteers, funded by sponsors.
The flagship 36-hour LA Hacks returns to UCLA's Pauley Pavilion in mid-April 2027.
AI Hackathon 2026 runs Oct 17-18, 2026 at the James West Alumni Center, UCLA.

organizations.name: Even Realities
organizations.oneLiner: Makes Even G2 display smart glasses and the Even R1 smart ring.

focusNow.text: Even Hub, announced Mar 2026, is an open platform for developers to build and ship apps for the G2.
G2 apps are web apps (HTML/CSS/TypeScript) using the Even Hub SDK over Bluetooth to a 576x288 display.
Even Realities lists the G2 glasses and the R1 ring (controls the G2) as its products.

organizations.name: CREAO
organizations.oneLiner: Builds AI agents that run recurring business work on schedules or triggers.

focusNow.text: Users describe a recurring task and CREAO builds an agent that runs on schedules, webhooks or Slack.
CREAO Lite is an in-house model the company says gives about 95% of frontier quality at about 5% of cost.
Raised $10M led by Prosperity7 Ventures, about $25M total, per press coverage.

organizations.name: Photon
organizations.oneLiner: Open-source Spectrum framework that puts AI agents into iMessage and other chats.

focusNow.text: Spectrum is a TypeScript SDK for agents on iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, SMS/RCS and more.
Photon 2.0, a rebuilt platform with a unified API, is in beta.

organizations.name: Sentry
organizations.oneLiner: Application monitoring: errors, tracing, logs and an AI debugging agent (Seer).

focusNow.text: Seer, Sentry's AI debugging agent, now covers local development and code review, with flat-rate pricing.
Seer uses production telemetry (errors, traces, logs, metrics) to root-cause bugs.

organizations.hiring: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027) and New Grad (2027) roles listed; see sentry.io/careers.

organizations.name: Visa
organizations.oneLiner: Global payments network connecting consumers, merchants and banks.

focusNow.text: Visa posts Software Engineer Intern roles for students graduating Dec 2026 or 2027.

organizations.hiring: Software Engineer Intern roles (BS/MS, graduating Dec 2026 or 2027); see Visa careers.

organizations.name: Fetch.ai
organizations.oneLiner: Agent platform: uAgents framework, Agentverse marketplace and ASI:One discovery.

focusNow.text: uAgents builds agents, Agentverse hosts them, and ASI:One routes a user's query to the right agent.
At LA Hacks spring 2026 it ran 'Best Use of Fetch.ai' ($5,000 pool) and 'Best OmegaClaw Skill powered by Agentverse'.
Fetch.ai says over 2 million agents coordinate through Agentverse.

organizations.eventRole: sponsor: likely Agentverse / Best Use of Fetch.ai track (confirm)
organizations.hiring: Spring 2026 LA Hacks winners got an internship interview opportunity.

organizations.name: Cognition
organizations.oneLiner: Makes Devin, the AI software engineer, and the Windsurf editor (now Devin Desktop).

focusNow.text: Windsurf was renamed Devin Desktop on June 2, 2026; Devin Local is the default local agent.
Cognition acquired the Windsurf product and brand in July 2025.

organizations.hiring: Careers page lists roles in R&D, customer engineering, sales, marketing; no internship listed.

organizations.name: Paper
organizations.oneLiner: Design tool with an HTML/CSS canvas that AI agents can read and write via MCP.

focusNow.text: Every layer is real HTML/CSS, so designs export as code; any IDE or CLI agent connects over MCP.
Paper raised a $34M Series A led by Accel and ICONIQ.
Paper Desktop launched in early 2026; Paper reports ARR grew 25x in one month afterward.

organizations.name: Base44
organizations.oneLiner: Wix-owned AI platform that builds apps, sites and agents from plain-language prompts.

focusNow.text: Apps ship with built-in backend, auth, database and hosting; 'Superagents' automate workflows.
Reported to have launched Base1, its first in-house model for building web apps, on June 29, 2026.
Wix bought Base44 in June 2025; Wix reported about $100M ARR for it by March 2026.

organizations.name: QNX
organizations.oneLiner: BlackBerry division building real-time OSes for cars, robots and safety-critical systems.

focusNow.text: QNX SDP 8.0 is the base for its next-generation products, including QNX Hypervisor.
Alloy Kore, a foundation layer for software-defined vehicles, was picked by Coretura (Daimler Truck and Volvo Group JV).
QNX markets deterministic 'physical AI' workloads and reports deployment in over 275 million vehicles.

organizations.name: Workday
organizations.oneLiner: Cloud software for HR and finance, now pushing AI agents (Sana).

focusNow.text: Sana from Workday, an AI interface and self-service agents for HR and finance, became generally available Mar 17, 2026.
On Oct 13, 2026 Workday said Sana will work inside Claude, Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Slack and Teams.

organizations.name: Veri
organizations.oneLiner: Infrastructure for continually improving AI: training, evals and deployment.

focusNow.text: Product covers SFT/DPO/GRPO training on usage data, autoscaling endpoints, LLM-judge monitors and sandboxed agents.
A Python SDK defines training jobs and reward functions in code.

organizations.name: Intuit QuickBooks
organizations.oneLiner: Intuit's small-business accounting platform, with AI agents built in.

focusNow.text: Intuit Assist is its generative AI assistant across TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks and Mailchimp.
Intuit Intelligence gives a virtual team of AI agents for customers, payments, payroll, accounting and tax.

organizations.name: Espressif
organizations.oneLiner: Chipmaker behind the ESP32 family of Wi-Fi/Bluetooth microcontrollers.

focusNow.text: Espressif says it has shipped over 1.5 billion IoT SoCs and has 3 million+ ecosystem developers.
ESP-IDF v6.0 gives stable support for ESP32-C5 and C61 and previews ESP32-H21 and H4.
Current lines include ESP32-S, P (P4), C, E and H series, plus modules and DevKits.

organizations.name: Major League Hacking
organizations.oneLiner: Student hackathon league and developer community (also owns DEV).

focusNow.text: MLH reports 5 million+ developers and 1,000+ events a year across 100 countries.
The MLH Fellowship is a 12-week remote internship alternative on open source, with a stipend.

organizations.hiring: MLH Fellowship (12-week remote; software, production engineering, web3 tracks); careers at careers.mlh.io.

organizations.name: GoDaddy Registry
organizations.oneLiner: Runs 200+ top-level domains and registry DNS; formerly Neustar's registry.

focusNow.text: Supports 200+ TLDs and 8 million+ domains, with DNS on UltraDNS handling 40B+ queries per day.
GoDaddy Registry has a history of giving free domains to MLH hackathon participants.

organizations.eventRole: sponsor: free domain for your project (confirm)

organizations.name: Vultr
organizations.oneLiner: Independent cloud provider with GPU and CPU compute in 30+ regions.

focusNow.text: Vultr Clusters offers on-demand, self-service GPU and CPU clusters (announced April 2026).
Vultr added a 33rd cloud region in Milan, Italy in May 2026.
Vultr says it is among the first NVIDIA Exemplar Clouds for Blackwell GPUs.

organizations.name: ElevenLabs
organizations.oneLiner: Voice AI: text-to-speech, speech-to-text and conversational voice agents.

focusNow.text: Raised a $500M Series D at an $11B valuation led by Sequoia, announced Feb 2026.
Funds go to ElevenAgents (enterprise voice and chat agents) and research; Eleven v3 supports 70+ languages.
Reported to have passed $500M annualized revenue in the first four months of 2026.

organizations.hiring: Careers page lists ~156 roles (agents, research engineering, revenue); hubs in London, NYC, SF, Warsaw. No internship listed.

organizations.name: Google
organizations.oneLiner: Google's Gemini models and API for building multimodal and agentic apps.

focusNow.text: Gemini API docs list Gemini 4 Argon as flagship reasoning model and Gemini 3.8 Flash for agents and coding.
Gemini 3.8 Live is the default Live API model for low-latency voice agents.
Developer offerings include Deep Research agents, Nano Banana image models, Veo video and Lyria music.

organizations.name: Snowflake
organizations.oneLiner: AI data cloud for analytics and enterprise AI agents.

focusNow.text: At Summit (June 1-4, 2026) Snowflake announced CoWork (formerly Snowflake Intelligence), a personal work agent.
Cortex Code, a Snowflake-native AI coding agent, launched Feb 3, 2026 and was expanded in April.

organizations.name: Solana
organizations.oneLiner: High-throughput layer-1 blockchain; the Foundation funds ecosystem builders.

focusNow.text: The Solana Foundation is a Zug-based nonprofit focused on decentralization, adoption and security of Solana.
Foundation runs a Grants Program and a Validator Delegation Program for builders and operators.
Alpenglow, a consensus overhaul targeting ~100-150ms finality, was on a community testnet in May 2026; mainnet date unconfirmed.

organizations.name: Tiger Data
organizations.oneLiner: Postgres platform for time-series and sensor data, from the makers of TimescaleDB.

focusNow.text: Offers Postgres with time-based partitioning, row-columnar compression and tiered storage on object storage.
Also pitches hybrid search (keywords, vectors, filters) and Iceberg replication; cites CERN as a customer.
